name: nvidia_api
description: Test an Nvidia NIM API key: measure latency and uptime (ping), list the models the key can currently see, and run one short chat completion as a smoke test. Reports the exact failure class (no key / auth / quota / network) instead of guessing, and never fabricates a latency or a model list.

operation.description: One of: ping | models | chat | check. ping measures latency/uptime; models lists the live catalogue; chat runs one tiny completion; check verifies the key without listing models. Defaults to ping.

model.description: Optional model id for the chat operation. Defaults to the first model the key can see.

author: Stella
